summary.text: After a Desolation, Kalak found only Jezrien at the Heralds' meeting place, and the two left their Honorblades and the Oathpact behind as the others had, leaving Talenel alone.
On the night of a treaty feast with the Parshendi, Szeth, a Shin assassin in white, killed King Gavilar, who gave him a black sphere and a message for his brother Dalinar.
In Brightlord Amaram's army, the new recruit Cenn was saved in his first battle by his squadleader, Kaladin Stormblessed, until an enemy Shardbearer came.

roles.dallet: Returned Cenn to the squad; was asked to mind him

summary.text: Eight months later, Kaladin was a branded slave in Tvlakv's caravan, where a windspren began to talk to him.

roles.bluth: Killed the sick slave Kaladin said could be saved

summary.text: Shallan landed in Kharbranth and climbed to the Conclave with the sailor Yalb, still chasing Jasnah Kholin.
When Tvlakv got lost, Kaladin refused to help, but the windspren spotted people ahead: the caravan was bound for the warcamps on the Shattered Plains.

roles.bluth: With Tvlakv's caravan when it lost its way

summary.text: Jasnah Soulcast a fallen stone to free King Taravangian's granddaughter, then turned Shallan down as her ward; Shallan's real aim was to steal Jasnah's Soulcaster.

roles.tvlakv: Called Kaladin a deserter while selling him to Sadeas' army
roles.bluth: Arrived with Tvlakv's caravan at Sadeas' warcamp

summary.text: Sold to Sadeas' army as a bridgeman, Kaladin survived his first bridge run, and the windspren told him her name: Sylphrena, or Syl.

roles.gaz: Disliked Kaladin and put him at the bridge's front

summary.text: Waiting in Jasnah's alcove at the Palanaeum, Shallan wrote her a letter and met Kabsal, an ardent hoping to convert Jasnah.
Won over by Shallan's self-taught studies and persistence, Jasnah took her as her ward.
Weeks into bridge duty, with nearly everyone from his first run dead, Kaladin sank into despair and Syl left him.
Nine years earlier in Hearthstone, young Kal helped his father, the surgeon Lirin, treat a girl's hand, and argued that soldiers could save lives too.
At the edge of a chasm after a highstorm, Kaladin chose not to jump when Syl came back to him.
Kaladin forced Gaz to make him bridgeleader of Bridge Four.

roles.teft: In the barrack as Kaladin began asking the men's names

summary.text: At the Davar estate, Shallan's brother Balat brooded over her mission until Wikim came to tell him of a big problem.
Szeth served Took, who showed off his obedience in mining towns, until thugs killed Took and took Szeth's Oathstone.
On a chasmfiend hunt with King Elhokar and Sadeas, Dalinar raced the king up a rock and, remembering a voice telling him to unite them, let him win.

summary.text: Dalinar beat Elhokar in a scuffle, got him to admit he had cut his own strap, and told him to name Dalinar Highprince of War.
Shallan worked out that Jasnah's Soulcaster was fake, went back to the place of beads to prove it, and Jasnah agreed to teach her.
Szeth came to kill King Taravangian, the last name on his list, and found the king was his master, who added Dalinar Kholin to the list.
Jasnah's notes led Shallan to see that the Voidbringers had not been destroyed but enslaved, as the parshmen.
Dalinar made Kaladin a captain with Bridge Four as his guard, and the men asked Kaladin to teach them his powers.

summary.text: Shallan and Jasnah planned to sail for the Shattered Plains, and Jasnah named Kabsal a Ghostblood, a group Shallan realised her father had likely belonged to.
In a last vision Dalinar learned the voice had never heard him; it told him to refound the Knights Radiant and said the Almighty was dead, killed by Odium.
In Kholinar, Wit was talking with the guards when Talenel staggered in with a Shardblade, warned of a coming Desolation and collapsed.
Joshor of the king's Silent Gatherers wrote down a dying Herdazian's ketek and left its meaning for the king.

pins.title: The Heralds leave their Blades
pins.text: Kalak and Jezrien left their Honorblades with the others' and walked away from the Oathpact, leaving Talenel to bear it alone.

pins.title: Gavilar assassinated
pins.text: On the night of the treaty feast with the Parshendi, the Shin assassin Szeth killed King Gavilar.

pins.title: Kaladin joins Bridge Four
pins.text: Sold to Sadeas' army, Kaladin was made a bridgeman in Bridge Four, and the windspren told him her name, Syl.

pins.title: Shallan becomes Jasnah's ward
pins.text: Won over by Shallan's persistence, Jasnah took her on as her ward.

pins.title: Took killed
pins.text: Thugs killed Szeth's master Took and made off with Szeth's Oathstone.

pins.title: The chasmfiend hunt
pins.text: When Elhokar's saddle strap broke on the hunt, Dalinar held off the chasmfiend until the king killed it.

pins.title: Wistiow dies
pins.text: Hearthstone's citylord Wistiow died, leaving Kal spheres to study surgery in Kharbranth.

pins.title: Dalinar decides to step down
pins.text: Doubting his visions and his own mind, Dalinar told Navani he meant to abdicate as highprince.

pins.title: Szeth's list
pins.text: Szeth's new master took his Oathstone and gave him a list of noblemen to kill.

pins.title: Shallan draws the symbolheads
pins.text: Sketching King Taravangian, Shallan drew strange figures with symbols for heads that weren't there.

pins.title: Kaladin survives the highstorm
pins.text: Strung up outside the barrack through a highstorm, Kaladin was found alive afterwards.

pins.title: Soulcaster stolen
pins.text: After Jasnah killed the thugs who followed them into an alley, Shallan swapped Jasnah's Soulcaster for her broken one.

pins.title: Tien drafted
pins.text: Roshone had Tien drafted into Amaram's army, and Kaladin enlisted to protect him.

pins.title: The place of beads
pins.text: Fleeing the symbolheads, Shallan found herself in a sea of glass beads and turned a goblet into blood.

pins.title: Kaladin kills a Shardbearer
pins.text: After an enemy Shardbearer cut down most of his squad, Kaladin killed him and refused the Shards.

pins.title: Kabsal dies
pins.text: Kabsal died after eating his own bread, and Jasnah saved the poisoned Shallan with the stolen Soulcaster.

pins.title: Amaram's betrayal
pins.text: Amaram had Kaladin's last men killed, took the Shards for himself and had Kaladin branded a slave.

pins.title: Hanavanar assassinated
pins.text: Szeth killed King Hanavanar and his Shardbearers at a banquet in Vedenar.

pins.title: Kaladin draws in Stormlight
pins.text: Teft tricked Kaladin into drawing in Stormlight, and Syl admitted she wasn't a windspren.

pins.title: The visions are real
pins.text: Navani realised that Dalinar spoke the lost Dawnchant in his visions, proof they were real.

pins.title: Battle of the Tower
pins.text: Dalinar and Sadeas attacked the Tower together, until Sadeas pulled out and left Dalinar's army surrounded.

pins.title: Tien dies
pins.text: Sent to the front line as bait in his first battle, Tien was killed.

pins.title: Bridge Four's rescue
pins.text: Glowing with Stormlight, Kaladin led Bridge Four back to bridge a way out for Dalinar's army.

pins.title: Dalinar trades his Shardblade
pins.text: Dalinar gave Sadeas his Shardblade for the freedom of all of Sadeas' bridgemen.

pins.title: Szeth finds his master
pins.text: Sent to kill King Taravangian, Szeth found that the king was his master.

pins.title: The parshmen are Voidbringers
pins.text: From Jasnah's notes, Shallan worked out that the Voidbringers had been enslaved, not destroyed, as the parshmen.

pins.title: The Almighty is dead
pins.text: In his last vision, Dalinar learned that the Almighty was dead and was told to refound the Knights Radiant.

pins.title: Talenel arrives
pins.text: Talenel staggered into Kholinar with a Shardblade, warned of a coming Desolation and collapsed.
